_meta.bands: pre-registered and frozen with this file: clear_relevant [2,3] (the take-the-MIN dual-prompt ensemble biases grades down), clear_irrelevant [0] strictly (any relevance credit to a clearly-irrelevant doc is the agreeableness failure the gate screens for), borderline [1,2]. Adjusting a band after any judge run is a protocol violation (owner doc §7 discipline).
